about.text: A traditional Greek brined cheese from shepherds of the Pindus and Kaimaktsalan mountains, with many irregular holes and a salty, slightly sharp taste. It is made from partly skimmed sheep's, goat's or mixed milk, set with rennet, drained in cloth and dry-salted. It is then matured at least three months in 10–12% brine, and the fat taken off in the whey is used for butter or manouri.
